description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes, Notice of Repudation of award of an Arbitrator (Employees Trust Fund Board Colombo 05) (E Only)
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the repudiation of an arbitrator's award under Section 20(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131). It is a formal legal notice regarding the cessation of a binding arbitration award, which falls squarely under the category of legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and legal procedures.
